page.title: Review queue
page.purpose: Show what needs a person: open findings, failing assets, stale evidence and the evidence behind each decision.

priorities.statement: The most consequential finding and its blast radius are visible before secondary filters or metadata.

claims.statement: The review queue is captured in default, empty and request-error states.
claims.rationale: Draft page authored ahead of implementation; promote to machine when the findings projection and page story exist.

states.description: Open findings are ranked by blast radius and one finding is selected.
No findings need a decision; the empty state explains what was checked.
The findings projection failed and a retry path remains visible.

regions.purpose: Render the ranked findings queue and its selected finding without hiding unavailable evidence.
